from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BasicEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of Basic Earnings Per Share data extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the financials belong to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific reporting period (e.g., quarter or year end date)")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label text used for the metric in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric EPS value; use negative for losses")
    excerpt: str = Field(description="Short text segment from the document confirming the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    basic_eps_records: list[BasicEPSRecord]
